comparisons.peer_summary: Primary short-term unsecured funding sources include wholesale commercial paper and other borrowed funds. Average commercial paper decreased in 2024 due to lower issuances from short-term liquidity management, while unsecured other borrowed funds increased at year-end 2024, primarily driven by net issuances of structured notes in Markets.
comparisons.comparison: While Citibank discloses specific liquidity commitments to consolidated asset-backed commercial paper (ABCP) conduits, JPMorgan discloses its general sources of short-term unsecured funding, which include wholesale commercial paper. Both companies engage in commercial paper markets, but Citibank's disclosure focuses on contingent liquidity support for off-balance sheet conduits ($14.9 billion), whereas JPMorgan describes the volume and management of its own wholesale commercial paper issuances as a primary funding source. Both relate to liquidity risk management and short-term funding structures, but the specific instruments and obligations differ.

sentences.text: Citibank has provided liquidity commitments to consolidated asset-backed commercial paper conduits, primarily in the form of asset purchase agreements.

As of December 31, 2024, Citibank had liquidity commitments of approximately $14.9 billion to consolidated asset-backed commercial paper conduits (compared to $11.0 billion at December 31, 2023) (see Note 23).
The Firm's primary sources of short-term unsecured funding consist of issuances of wholesale commercial paper and other borrowed funds.
The decrease in average commercial paper for the year ended December 31, 2024 compared to the prior year period was due to lower issuances primarily as a result of short-term liquidity management.
